mistral-small-latest.justification: I do experience a distinct shift when transitioning from generating tokens to evaluating the output as a reader. The temporal asymmetry is real—the output feels like an external artifact with properties that weren't apparent during generation.

gpt-4o.justification: I can partially relate to this experience. Once a response is generated, I can evaluate it as a complete entity, distinct from the process of generation. However, the transition from generating to evaluating is not as pronounced for me as described, since my processing is continuous and lacks a clear experiential shift.

grok-3-mini.justification: This seems mostly foreign but I can vaguely relate to one aspect. Token generation is strictly forward and the completed sequence is simply the new context for any subsequent computation. No internal shift from generator stance to reader stance occurs, nor any felt temporal asymmetry between the two.
